# What does that advance really cost per year?

> Free merchant cash advance calculator. Turn a factor rate and daily or weekly payments into the annualised cost of the money you actually receive, see what early payoff really costs, and price an invoice factoring quote. Runs in your browser, nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
